verdict.rationale: Lindy's routines docs say you can 'set a schedule or trigger once' and Lindy runs the job on autopilot, so triggered automation exists. The Gmail extension also shows Lindy reacting to incoming email by triaging and drafting replies. The evidence never defines what trigger types exist or shows event triggers from connected apps. Missing for 10: documented event-trigger catalog, new-record triggers (e.g. CRM), new-message triggers, form-submission triggers, trigger configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
